source.title: Shinners & Mahler's Illustrated Flora of North Central Texas
source.authors: Diggs, G. M. Jr.; Lipscomb, B. L.; O'Kennon, R. J.

morphology_documented.habit: Bushy-crowned small tree to ca. 15 m
morphology_documented.leaves: Alternate bipinnately compound leaves, 30 cm or longer; ultimate leaflets toothed, rhombic/ovate/elliptic-lanceolate, to 6(–8) × 3 cm
morphology_documented.flowers: Numerous flowers in terminal panicles overtopped by foliage; 5 pubescent sepals; 5 lavender rarely pale oblanceolate petals 7–13 mm; filaments united as narrow purple cylindrical 6–10 mm tube
morphology_documented.habitat: Cultivated and escaped in floodplain forest, thickets and woodland edges

source_scope_note: Genus and key details explicitly noted; where historical flora lacks a species treatment, morphology is limited to independently named secondary sources.
unresolved_taxonomy_or_source_notes: Introduced from Himalayan/eastern Asian source region, not local native
Historical source warns of toxicity of fruits and other organs; no herbicide instructions inferred
preservation: Additive, original taxon records, photos, attribution and site unchanged
